method.inputs: 157 label TXT files only; source image identities are inherited from the hash-bound parent manifest. No image pixels or predictions are read by this screen.
method.lower_edge: ymax - max(y of locatable lower-front keypoints); flag if greater than max(5px,0.25*box_height).
method.upper_edge: min(y of locatable lower-front keypoints) - ymin is recorded as front height context, not treated as a near-zero constraint.
method.overlap: Flag a box containing another object's locatable keypoint more than2px inside all four edges. Record every such foreign point and its vertical relation.
method.selection: Four largest qualifying lower-gap ratios, then four highest foreign-corner counts, one candidate per eligible new-series training photo; exclude held015, old-series treatment exclusions, protected standards and already-requested016.
method.threshold_status: Fixed inspection priorities chosen before visual review; not physical laws, automatic corrections, or tuned evaluation thresholds.

limits: Lower-front keypoints naturally lie near ymax, while their distance from ymin includes front height.
Perspective, rim thickness, occlusion and axis-aligned rectangles can create legitimate gaps and neighboring-point overlaps.
Unavailable corners supply no guessed location; zero-corner rows have no corner-to-bottom gap score.
Every amendment requires original-pixel adjudication. This screen never edits labels or copies predictions.
The eight selected cases are nonrandom review priorities, not a precision or dataset-error-rate sample.
